name: Hero Catalog
description: Complete definitions for every recruitable and promotable hero class.

Guardian.name: Guardian
Guardian.description: A heavily protected frontline hero who controls enemy attention and intercepts attacks aimed at vulnerable allies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the weakest ally +30 Defense and +36 Magic Defense for 3 turns; the Guardian gains +6 Threat and Intercept to pull enemy attacks onto itself.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +9 Threat, +17 Defense, and +25 Magic Defense; +9 more Defense and Magic Defense per living ally.

Knight.name: Knight
Knight.description: An armored defender who blocks routes, challenges dangerous enemies, and protects adjacent allies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 50% Attack damage, applies -9% Attack to all enemies, then gains +10 Threat and Intercept for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +8 Threat and +37 Immunity, plus +33 Defense and Magic Defense while at full Health. The whole party gains +14 Immunity.

Royal Bastion.name: Royal Bastion
Royal Bastion.description: An immovable champion whose presence shields the entire formation and denies enemies control of the frontline.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the whole party +40 Immunity for 3 turns, and takes +12 Threat with Intercept to pull enemy attacks onto itself.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +10 Threat, plus +4 more Defense and Magic Defense per living ally; the whole party gains +16 Defense and +12 Immunity.

Paladin.name: Paladin
Paladin.description: A sacred protector who combines defensive techniques with healing, cleansing, and protection from hostile magic.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the weakest ally for 150% Attack and grants it +28 Defense and +20 Immunity for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +40 Healing, +16 Defense, and +16 Magic Defense; the whole party gains +18 Immunity. After every action, Merciful Surge heals 1 wounded ally.

Dawn Warden.name: Dawn Warden
Dawn Warden.description: A radiant guardian who turns divine protection into powerful counterattacks and party-wide barriers.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the whole party +30 Magic Defense and +12 Immunity for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +3 Threat. The whole party gains +12 Magic Defense and +12 Immunity, and regenerates 2.2% of maximum Health each turn.

Fighter.name: Fighter
Fighter.description: A dependable melee combatant who builds momentum through sustained attacks and adapts to different weapons.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits one random enemy for 155% Attack damage, then gains +15% Damage for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Each basic attack adds +8% Damage (Momentum, stacks up to +42%) for the rest of the battle; +13% Damage against enemies below half Health.

Berserker.name: Berserker
Berserker.description: An aggressive warrior who trades defense and health for escalating damage, speed, and resistance to control.

stats.skill_act_desc: Costs 18% of maximum Health; hits one random enemy 3 times for 77% Attack damage per hit with +37 Critical Chance, then applies 18% Vulnerability for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Deals up to +125% Damage as Health drops below 50%, strongest near defeat; +22% Damage against enemies below half Health. Always +15 Lifesteal.

Blood Champion.name: Blood Champion
Blood Champion.description: A relentless destroyer who becomes most dangerous when wounded and can overwhelm entire enemy groups.

stats.skill_act_desc: Costs 20% of maximum Health; hits every enemy 3 times for 52% Attack damage per hit (72% on the primary target), and heals for 30% of the damage dealt.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +15 Lifesteal. Defeating an enemy heals 6% of maximum Health and grants +26.5% Damage for 3 turns. Survives the first lethal hit of each encounter at 1% of maximum Health.

Duelist.name: Duelist
Duelist.description: A precise combatant who parries attacks, exploits openings, and excels when fighting a single opponent.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 65% Attack damage and applies -30% Attack, then gains +30 Magic Defense and +50 Counter Chance for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +3 Threat, +25 Defense, +50 Counter Chance, and +8 Lifesteal; +60% Damage against enemies below half Health.

Swordmaster.name: Swordmaster
Swordmaster.description: A peerless weapon specialist who converts perfect timing and positioning into devastating finishing attacks.

stats.skill_act_desc: Costs 5% of maximum Health; hits one random enemy for 186% Attack damage with a guaranteed critical hit, then gains +57% Damage for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +30 Critical Chance and +15% Damage; the first strike against a new target deals +60% Damage, and +18% Damage lands on enemies below half Health.

Rogue.name: Rogue
Rogue.description: A fast, elusive hero who uses stealth, flanking, and critical strikes to eliminate priority targets.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 160% Attack damage with +37 Critical Chance on this hit, then gains +11 Evade for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +11 Evade; +16% Damage against enemies that have not acted yet this wave, and +22% Damage against enemies below half Health.

Assassin.name: Assassin
Assassin.description: A burst-damage specialist who marks isolated targets and attacks from concealment for lethal results.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the weakest enemy for 108% Attack damage with a guaranteed critical hit, gaining up to +241% Attack as its Health falls.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +10 Critical Chance and +14 Evade; the first hit on a new target gains +45 Critical Chance and +51% Damage.

Nightblade.name: Nightblade
Nightblade.description: A master killer who moves between shadows, chains executions, and disappears before enemies can retaliate.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy 2 times for 95% Attack damage per hit with +45 Critical Chance, applies 15% Vulnerability for 3 turns, and Silences it for 1 turn.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +40% Critical Damage. Defeating an enemy grants +52% Damage for 3 turns and +46 Evade for 2 turns.

Trickster.name: Trickster
Trickster.description: A disruptive skirmisher who uses feints, smoke, theft, and misdirection to manipulate the battlefield.

stats.skill_act_desc: Applies 18% Vulnerability and -8% Attack to every enemy for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +22 Evade and +10 Critical Chance; a successful evade grants +45% Damage for 2 turns.

Phantom.name: Phantom
Phantom.description: An untouchable saboteur who creates decoys, steals enemy advantages, and turns hostile plans against their owners.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 196% Attack damage with a guaranteed critical hit and applies 12% Vulnerability, then gains +25 Evade for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +18 Evade and +12 Critical Chance. A successful evade grants +50% Damage for 2 turns, and critical hits apply 9% Vulnerability to the target for 3 turns.

Ranger.name: Ranger
Ranger.description: A ranged hunter who scouts hostile territory, marks targets, and gains advantages from terrain and distance.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy 3 times for 60% Attack damage per hit, then gains +12 Critical Chance for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +32 Critical Chance and +60% Critical Damage; basic attacks ignore 27% Defense.

Sniper.name: Sniper
Sniper.description: A patient marksman who sacrifices mobility for exceptional range, armor penetration, and single-target damage.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy 3 times for 54% Attack damage per hit with +28 Critical Chance, ignoring 42% Defense, then applies -18% Attack for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +21 Critical Chance; +90% Damage on the Sniper's first action each wave.

Deadeye.name: Deadeye
Deadeye.description: A legendary shooter who exposes hidden weaknesses and can decide a battle with one perfectly prepared shot.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy 3 times for 28% Attack damage per hit, ignoring 37% Defense, then applies 12% Vulnerability for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +198% Critical Damage; basic attacks ignore 22% Defense, and the Deadeye deals +22% Damage on its first action each wave.

Beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
Beastmaster.description: A versatile hunter who fights alongside an animal companion and coordinates attacks with it.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy 3 times for 14% Attack damage per hit and applies -15% Attack, then gains +22 Defense for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +6 Threat, +20 Defense, +20 Magic Defense, and +14% Damage; +30 more Defense and Magic Defense while at full Health.

Wild Warden.name: Wild Warden
Wild Warden.description: A master of the hunt who commands a powerful bonded beast and turns the surrounding wilderness into an ally.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy 3 times for 32% Attack damage per hit with +45 Critical Chance, then gains +48 Defense for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +5 Threat and +27% Damage. Each allied basic attack gives the Wild Warden alone +6% Damage (Momentum, up to +52%) for the rest of the battle.

Cleric.name: Cleric
Cleric.description: A divine support hero who restores health, removes harmful conditions, and protects the party from supernatural threats.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the weakest ally for 150% Attack and cleanses its harmful statuses, then heals the whole party for 17% Attack.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +45 Healing and +52 Immunity; every heal performed restores 30 mana. After every action, Twin Mercy delivers a two-pulse heal to 1 wounded ally.

Priest.name: Priest
Priest.description: A dedicated healer who provides efficient restoration, blessings, and emergency protection for wounded allies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals every ally for 42% Attack, cleanses their harmful statuses, and grants the whole party +6 Immunity for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +40 Healing; the whole party gains +10 Healing and every heal performed cleanses its target. After every action, Shared Grace splits a heal between 2 wounded allies.

High Priest.name: High Priest
High Priest.description: A supreme spiritual healer whose miracles can rescue an entire party from defeat and restore fallen heroes.

stats.skill_act_desc: Revives one fallen ally at 60% Health; if none has fallen, heals the weakest ally for 140% Attack. Either way, cleanses that ally's harmful statuses.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +30 Healing, and 8% stronger healing while the High Priest is below 35% Health. Survives the first lethal hit of each encounter at 1% of maximum Health. After every action, Miracle's Wake heals 1 wounded ally (+50% below 35% Health).

Inquisitor.name: Inquisitor
Inquisitor.description: A battle cleric who exposes corruption, dispels enemy magic, and punishes cursed or supernatural foes.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 45% Attack damage, removes its buffs, and applies 38% Vulnerability for 3 turns; heals the whole party for 6% Attack.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +20% Damage, +20 Critical Chance, and +45 Immunity; the whole party gains +30 Healing.

Demon Hunter.name: Demon Hunter
Demon Hunter.description: A relentless purifier who seals hostile powers and specializes in destroying summoned, undead, and corrupted enemies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 189% Attack damage, ignoring 43% Defense, and Silences it for 1 turn; heals the whole party for 11% Attack.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +20% Damage, +45 Immunity, and +33 Healing. Resisting a harmful status grants +45% Damage for 3 turns.

Mage.name: Mage
Mage.description: A fragile spellcaster who spends mana to deal area damage, alter the battlefield, and control groups of enemies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 70% Attack damage; the primary target takes +48% Attack damage (118% total).
stats.skill_psv_desc: +70% Damage while mana is 50 or higher; casting the active skill restores 24 mana.

Elementalist.name: Elementalist
Elementalist.description: An offensive caster who combines fire, frost, lightning, and earth to exploit weaknesses and create reactions.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits one random enemy for 230% Attack damage, then applies one random element for 3 turns: -15% Attack, 12% Vulnerability, or -15 Evade.
stats.skill_psv_desc: +60% Damage against any enemy with a harmful status active, and +35% Damage while mana is 50 or higher.

Archon.name: Archon
Archon.description: A living conduit of elemental power who reshapes large areas and chains multiple elements into catastrophic spells.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 66% Attack damage and applies one random element for 3 turns: -15% Attack, 12% Vulnerability, or -15 Evade. Gains +12 Critical Chance and restores 12 mana to every ally.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The whole party always gains +15 Critical Chance. The Archon's critical hits apply 20% Vulnerability to the target for 3 turns and restore 18 mana.

Arcanist.name: Arcanist
Arcanist.description: A technical mage who manipulates raw magic through barriers, teleportation, interruption, and spell amplification.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy for 206% Attack damage, applies Silence for 1 turn, and restores 30 mana.
stats.skill_psv_desc: +295% Damage against enemies affected by Silence; each critical hit restores 24 mana.

Grand Magus.name: Grand Magus
Grand Magus.description: A master of pure sorcery who rewrites the rules of combat by altering range, cost, timing, and magical effects.

stats.skill_act_desc: Applies 8% Vulnerability and one random element to every enemy for 3 turns: -15% Attack, 12% Vulnerability, or -15 Evade. Restores 20 mana to every ally and refunds 25 mana to the Grand Magus.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +25% Damage, and +100% Damage while mana is 50 or higher. Any allied critical hit restores 8 mana to the Grand Magus.

Bard.name: Bard
Bard.description: A charismatic support hero who maintains performances that strengthen allies, weaken enemies, and shape party morale.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the whole party +14% Damage and +11 Critical Chance for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The party always gains +6% Damage; the Bard gains +15 Critical Chance. Casting the active skill restores 26 mana. After every action, Restorative Refrain splits a heal between 2 wounded allies.

Minstrel.name: Minstrel
Minstrel.description: An inspiring performer who sustains healing melodies, resource recovery, and long-lasting party enhancements.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the weakest ally for 150% Attack and grants it +32 Critical Chance for 3 turns, then restores 12 mana to every ally.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +40 Healing; the party gains +8 Healing and +4 Critical Chance, and every heal performed restores 20 mana. After every action, Threefold Ballad splits a 3-pulse heal between 2 wounded allies.

Virtuoso.name: Virtuoso
Virtuoso.description: A brilliant artist who layers several performances at once and transforms party coordination into overwhelming tempo.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the whole party +13% Damage, +15 Critical Chance, and +15 Immunity, and applies 4% Vulnerability to every enemy. Lasts 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The whole party always gains +9% Damage and +14 Immunity. Any allied critical hit restores 40 mana to the Virtuoso. After every action, Grand Healing Chorus splits a heal between 3 wounded allies.

Skald.name: Skald
Skald.description: A martial storyteller whose battle chants improve offense, courage, and resistance while pressuring nearby enemies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the whole party +17% Damage and +14 Immunity for 3 turns, and restores 17 mana to every ally.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The party always gains +7% Damage; the Skald gains +8% Damage and +14 Critical Chance. Each of the Skald's critical hits restores 30 mana.

War Chanter.name: War Chanter
War Chanter.description: A commanding voice on the battlefield who drives allies into heroic action and breaks the resolve of enemy formations.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the whole party +16% Damage and +9 Critical Chance for 3 turns, applies -3% Attack to every enemy, and restores 18 mana to every ally.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The whole party always gains +8% Damage and +5 Critical Chance. Each enemy an ally defeats gives the War Chanter alone +5% Damage (Momentum, up to +25%) for the rest of the battle.

Engineer.name: Engineer
Engineer.description: A tactical specialist who deploys devices, traps, and consumable inventions to prepare and control the battlefield.

stats.skill_act_desc: Shields the whole party (9% of maximum Health, until broken), applies -12% Attack to all enemies, and grants the Engineer +33 Defense for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +5 Threat and +25 Immunity. Gains a barrier of 3% maximum Health at each wave start; below 35% Health, raises another of 40% maximum Health, once every 4 turns.

Artificer.name: Artificer
Artificer.description: A magical inventor who equips allies with enchanted devices, protective constructs, and adaptable utility tools.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the strongest ally +68% Damage, +24 Critical Chance, and +6 Defense for 3 turns, plus a barrier worth 10% of their maximum Health until broken.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The party always gains +5% Damage; the Artificer gains +8% Damage and +15 Critical Chance. Casting the active skill grants a barrier worth 12% of maximum Health.

Master Artificer.name: Master Artificer
Master Artificer.description: A visionary creator whose autonomous constructs and legendary equipment can redefine the party's capabilities.

stats.skill_act_desc: Shields the whole party (22% of maximum Health, until broken), grants +15 Immunity for 3 turns, and restores 8 mana to every ally.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +22 Healing. Gains a barrier of 6% maximum Health at each wave start, and every heal performed grants its target a barrier worth 10% of their maximum Health. After every action, Repair Sequence splits a 2-pulse heal between 2 wounded allies.

Machinist.name: Machinist
Machinist.description: A battlefield operator who deploys turrets, explosives, and mechanical weapons to control key positions.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits one random enemy 3 times for 68% Attack damage per hit, ignoring 49% Defense, then shields itself for 10% of maximum Health until broken.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +16 Critical Chance; basic attacks ignore 15% Defense and each adds +5% Damage (Momentum, up to +36%) for the rest of the battle. Below 35% Health, raises a barrier of 45% maximum Health, once every 4 turns.

Siege Architect.name: Siege Architect
Siege Architect.description: A master of heavy machinery who constructs fortified positions and brings overwhelming mechanical firepower.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy 3 times for 22% Attack damage per hit and applies -10% Attack, shields the whole party (3.5% of maximum Health, until broken), and gains +24 Defense for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +3 Threat, +32 Defense, and +32 Magic Defense. Gains a barrier of 1.5% maximum Health at each wave start and 12% on each active skill cast; below 35% Health, raises 40% more, once every 4 turns.

Monk.name: Monk
Monk.description: A disciplined combatant who generates focus through movement, counters, and attack combinations before spending it on advanced techniques.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits one random enemy for 39% Attack damage and applies 26% Vulnerability, then gains +78 Counter Chance and +28 Counter Power for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The party always gains +7 Critical Chance; the Monk gains +31 Counter Chance. Critical hits apply 21% Vulnerability to the target for 3 turns.

Martial Artist.name: Martial Artist
Martial Artist.description: A mobile melee specialist who changes stances, completes combos, and counters predictable enemy attacks.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits the strongest enemy 3 times for 53% Attack damage per hit, ignoring 24% Defense, then gains +53 Counter Chance and +31 Defense for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +55 Counter Chance, +38 Counter Power, and +18 Critical Chance; each active skill cast adds +10% Damage (Momentum, up to +35%) for the rest of the battle.

Grandmaster.name: Grandmaster
Grandmaster.description: A flawless combatant who flows freely between stances and turns enemy aggression into decisive counterattacks.

stats.skill_act_desc: Gains +12 Threat and Intercept to pull enemy attacks onto itself, plus +25 Magic Defense, +40 Counter Chance, and +25 Counter Power for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +12 Threat, +60 Counter Chance, and +30 Immunity. When an ally takes damage, gains +45 Counter Chance for 2 turns; resisting a harmful status grants +50% Damage for 3 turns.

Mystic.name: Mystic
Mystic.description: A spiritual support fighter who channels focus into barriers, cleansing techniques, and restorative energy.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the whole party for 44% Attack and grants every ally +13 Counter Chance, +6 Counter Power, and +6 Immunity for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +24 Healing and +44 Counter Chance; the party gains +8 Magic Defense. Every heal cleanses its target, and gaining mana heals the weakest ally for 3.9% of their maximum Health. After every action, Spirit Balance heals 2 wounded allies.

Enlightened One.name: Enlightened One
Enlightened One.description: A transcendent guardian who shares focus with allies and protects the party through perfect spiritual balance.

stats.skill_act_desc: Equalizes the party's Health, heals the whole party for 38% Attack, and grants every ally +15 Immunity for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +40 Healing; the whole party gains +2% Damage and +12 Immunity. Gaining mana heals the weakest ally 2.5%; overflow past 100 mana heals every ally 9%. After every action, Balanced Restoration heals 3 wounded allies.

Druid.name: Druid
Druid.description: A nature-bound hero who builds harmony by cycling abilities and uses it to transform creatures, terrain, and weather.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the weakest ally 42% Attack Regeneration and heals the whole party for 12% Attack, then applies 15% Attack DoT to every enemy. Lasts 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +40 Healing and +4% Damage; Regeneration effects are 6% stronger and the Druid recovers 3% of maximum Health each turn. After every action, Renewing Seed heals 1 wounded ally, half of it as a 2-turn Regeneration.

Shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
Shapeshifter.description: An adaptable combatant who assumes animal forms suited to defense, mobility, or close-range damage.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the Shapeshifter +37 Defense, +37 Magic Defense, +10% Damage, and 16% Attack Regeneration for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +3 Threat, +40 Defense, +40 Magic Defense, and +8% Damage; recovers 3.5% of maximum Health each turn.

Primal Avatar.name: Primal Avatar
Primal Avatar.description: An embodiment of the wild who combines traits from multiple beasts and transforms without sacrificing momentum.

stats.skill_act_desc: Silences every enemy for 1 turn. For 3 turns, applies -14% Attack to every enemy, grants the whole party 7% Attack Regeneration, and gives the Primal Avatar +24 Immunity.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +10 Threat, +30 Defense, +30 Magic Defense, and +25 Immunity; regenerates 5% of maximum Health each turn.

Grove Keeper.name: Grove Keeper
Grove Keeper.description: A nature caster who grows healing plants, restrains enemies with roots, and creates favorable terrain.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the whole party 17% Attack Regeneration and +8 Immunity for 3 turns, and restores 16 mana to every ally.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +50 Immunity; Regeneration effects are 8% stronger and the Grove Keeper recovers 5% of maximum Health each turn. After every action, Verdant Regrowth splits a heal between 2 wounded allies.

Archdruid.name: Archdruid
Archdruid.description: A supreme keeper of nature who commands forests and storms, causing the battlefield itself to aid the party.

stats.skill_act_desc: Applies 18% Attack DoT to every enemy, which ignores Defense and cannot be evaded, and grants the whole party 16% Attack Regeneration and +5 Immunity. Lasts 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +8% Damage; Regeneration effects are 6% stronger and the whole party regenerates 3% of maximum Health each turn. After every action, Restorative Rain heals 3 wounded allies, half as 2-turn Regeneration, doubled below 35% Health.

Warlock.name: Warlock
Warlock.description: A forbidden caster who accumulates corruption to fuel unusually powerful curses and summons at personal risk.

stats.skill_act_desc: Costs 10% of maximum Health; hits the strongest enemy for 100% Attack damage, then applies 75% Attack DoT for 3 turns. The DoT bypasses Defense and evasion.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +26% Damage and +10 Lifesteal; suffers 2 Decay damage after every action.

Hexbinder.name: Hexbinder
Hexbinder.description: A curse specialist who weakens enemies and places delayed hexes that trigger when specific conditions are met.

stats.skill_act_desc: Applies 28% Attack DoT, 38% Vulnerability, and -6% Attack to the strongest enemy for 3 turns. The DoT bypasses Defense and evasion.
stats.skill_psv_desc: +34% Damage against any enemy with a harmful status active; critical hits apply 30% Vulnerability for 3 turns.

Doomcaller.name: Doomcaller
Doomcaller.description: A master of inevitable ruin whose curses spread between enemies and convert their failures into further calamities.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy for 36% Attack damage (98% on the primary target), applies 34% Attack DoT for 3 turns, and Silences them for 1 turn. The DoT bypasses Defense and evasion.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +20% Damage; DoT effects are 10% stronger and every DoT tick on an enemy restores 4 mana. Defeating an enemy grants +24% Damage for 3 turns.

Demonologist.name: Demonologist
Demonologist.description: A dangerous summoner who sacrifices health or control to bind powerful infernal creatures.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits one random enemy 2 times for 75% Attack damage per hit, then applies 30% Attack DoT, shields itself for 12% of maximum Health until broken, and gains +11 Defense for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +20% Damage; DoT effects are 10% stronger. Suffers 2 Decay damage after every action, and survives the first lethal hit of each encounter at 1% of maximum Health.

Infernal Lord.name: Infernal Lord
Infernal Lord.description: A supreme binder who commands several demons, transfers corruption to them, and unleashes their full forbidden power.

stats.skill_act_desc: Hits every enemy 3 times for 28% Attack damage per hit (53% on the primary target) and applies 6% Vulnerability, then gains +16 Defense for 3 turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always +18% Damage and +40 Immunity, and +40% Damage against any enemy with a harmful status active. Defeating an enemy heals 14% of maximum Health.
